scoring_justification: Raw total energies not in output contract; structural audit of sign pattern and peak location verifies claims without needing exact numeric reproduction.

outputs.description: Twin boundary formation energy per unit area for 3C-SiC, Si, and diamond. The checker will verify sign and approximate magnitude without requiring exact numerical reproduction.
n-th stacking fault energy for 3C-SiC (n=1..10). The checker will verify that the 2nd value is the most negative (minimum) and negative in sign.

output_contract.notes: Scoring uses T3 structural auditing: formation energies must show the correct sign pattern (SiC negative, Si positive, diamond large positive); the stacking fault series must show a negative minimum at n=2.

steps.description: Check sign pattern of formation energies: SiC negative, Si positive, diamond >50 mJ/m².
Verify that the 2nd stacking fault energy is the most negative and negative, and that higher-order energies are within [-5,5] mJ/m².
